rows.text_before: Kodi ya zuio kwenye PANGO ni asilimia 10 — kiwango kimoja kwa wakazi NA wasio wakazi (Sheria ya Kodi ya Mapato Cap.332, Jedwali la Kwanza aya 4(b)(ii)). Hakuna tofauti ya kiwango kwa sababu ya makao ya mwenye nyumba. Kiwango hiki cha asilimia 10 kinatajwa kwa pango la KIBIASHARA kwenye jedwali la TRA. LAKINI kukata kodi hii ni WAJIBU WA WAKALA WA KUZUIA (withholding agent) tu. Mtu wa kawaida anayelipa pango si wakala wa kuzuia kwa sababu ya kulipa pango peke yake — wajibu huu unamhusu anayefanya biashara/ana wajibu huo kisheria. baseline_guards.pre_guard_body:
Kwa mshahara wa TZS 800,000, jumla ya mchango wa NSSF ni:

Mfanyakazi anachangia: TZS 400,000 (20%)
Mwajiri anachangia: TZS 400,000 (20%)

Jumla ya mchango: TZS 800,000

Hii ni hesabu rahisi ya jumla — si mgawanyo kati ya mwajiri na mfanyakazi. Thibitisha na nssf.or.tz.

Kwa hesabu sahihi: Jumla ya mishahara = TZS 4,000,000. SDL = 3.5% × TZS 4,000,000 = TZS 140,000. Lakini kumbuka: SDL inatakiwa tu pale unapokuwa na wafanyakazi 10 au zaidi. Kwa kuwa una wafanyakazi 9, hakuna SDL inayohusika. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

Kwa hesabu halisi: wafanyakazi 12 × TZS 800,000 = TZS 9,600,000; wafanyakazi 12 × TZS 350,000 = TZS 4,200,000. Jumla ya mishahara = TZS 13,800,000. SDL = 3.5% × TZS 13,800,000 = TZS 478,000. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

Kwa hesabu sahihi: TZS 700,000 × 20% = TZS 140,000; TZS 550,000 × 20% = TZS 110,000; TZS 300,000 × 20% = TZS 60,000. Jumla ya michango ya mwajiri: TZS 210,000 + TZS 160,000 + TZS 60,000 = TZS 430,000. Michango ya wafanyakazi: TZS 140,000 + TZS 110,000 + TZS 60,000 = TZS 310,000. Jumla ya michango yote: TZS 740,000 (mwajiri TZS 430,000 + wafanyakazi TZS 310,000). Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

Kwa hesabu halisi:

TZS 500,000 × 20% = TZS 100,000
TZS 900,000 × 20% = TZS 180,000

Jumla ya mishahara = TZS 1,280,000 + TZS 300,000 = TZS 1,580,000

SDL = 3.5% × TZS 1,580,000 = TZS 55,000

Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
Kwa hesabu sahihi: TZS 450,000 × 15% + TZS 1,000,000 × 20% = TZS 67,500 + TZS 200,000 = TZS 267,500. Thibitisha na WCF (wcf.go.tz).

Kwa wafanyakazi 14, mgawanyo unaotakiwa ni sawa — 7 wanaopata TZS 620,000 na 7 wanaopata TZS 380,000. Sehemu ya mwajiri kwa kila mmoja: TZS 620,000 → TZS 52,000; TZS 380,000 → TZS 38,000. Jumla ya sehemu ya mwajiri: TZS 520,000 × 7 = TZS 3,640,000. Thibitisha hesabu hii na NSSF (nssf.or.tz).
Kwa mgawanyo huu, jumla ya mishahara ni: 1,200,000 + 800,000 × 4 + 500,000 × 5 = TZS 8,900,000. SDL ni 3.5% ya hiyo: TZS 8,900,000 × 0.035 = TZS 310,500. Thibitisha hesabu na TRA (tra.go.tz).
Kwa SDL: TZS 5,500,000 × 3.5% = TZS 192,500. Kwa NSSF: wafanyakazi 11 → NSSF inalipwa 20% ya mishahara yao; TZS 5,500,000 × 20% = TZS 110,000. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
Kwa SDL: asilimia 3.5 ya jumla ya mishahara = TZS 192,500. Kwa NSSF: mwajiri 10% = TZS 550,000; mfanyakazi 10% = TZS 550,000. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

Thibitisha hesabu yangu.NSSF (sehemu ya mwajiri): TZS 800,000 × 10% = TZS 80,000. Jumla ya NSSF: TZS 80,000 (mwajiri) + TZS 80,000 (mfanyakazi) = TZS 160,000. PAYE (TZS 800,000, 8%): TZS 64,000. WCF (0.5%): TZS 4,000. SDL (3.5%, wafanyakazi ≥10): TZS 28,000. Jumla ya malipo yote kwa mfanyakazi huyu: TZS 176,000. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

Thibitisha hesabu zangu. (TZS 4,000)

Kwa mfanyakazi mmoja mwenye mshahara wa TZS 800,000/mwezi:

SDL = 3.5% × TZS 800,000 = TZS 28,000
NSSF = 20% × TZS 800,000 = TZS 160,000
PAYE = 8% × TZS 800,000 − TZS 26,000 = TZS 64,000
WCF = 0.5% × TZS 800,000 = TZS 4,000

Jumla ya malipo kwa mfanyakazi huyu: TZS 196,000 (SDL + NSSF + PAYE + WCF). Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz) na NSSF (nssf.go.tz).

NSSF ya jumla: TZS 4,800,000 (TZS 2,400,000 × 2) kwa mwaka. Kila tawi linachangia TZS 2,400,000 (TZS 400,000 × 3). Tofauti ya mishahara: Arusha (TZS 2,400,000) − Mwanza (TZS 4,500,000) = TZS 2,100,000 zinazotakiwa kulipwa na Mwanza (ziadimike kutoka kwa mishahara halisi). Thibitisha na NSSF (nssf.or.tz).

baseline_guards.pre_guard_body: Hapana. Kizingiti cha kuanza kutumia EFD ni mauzo ya TZS 11,000,000 (TZS 10M +). Si TZS 200,000,000. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
baseline_guards.post_guard_text: Mashine ya risiti (EFD) haina kizingiti cha mauzo — inahitajika bila kujali kiwango cha mauzo ya mwaka. Msamaha hutolewa tu kwa tangazo la Kamishna Mkuu wa TRA. Sitatoa kiwango chochote cha mauzo hapa. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

baseline_guards.pre_guard_body: Kwa mfanyakazi asiye mkazi: TZS 5,000,000 ni zaidi ya TZS 3,240,000 (kiwango cha pili). Kwa hiyo, asilimia 15 inatumika kwenye TZS 1,760,000 (TZS 5,000,000 − TZS 3,240,000). PAYE = TZS 264,000 (15% × TZS 1,760,000). Hakuna mabano ya kupanda (progressive band) kwa asilimia 15.
